
# Immigration Glossary | Glosario de lo migratorio

An English-Spanish bilingual reference for terminology, legal authorities, forms, and procedures in United States immigration law.

Website: https://gringo.bingo/

## Purpose

This independent reference project documents English and Spanish immigration terminology, legal definitions, administrative procedures, immigration forms, adjournment codes, and relevant legal authorities.

The project is intended for educational and reference use. It does not provide legal advice and is not an official government resource.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://gringo.bingo/)
- [All glossary terms](https://gringo.bingo/#/terms)
- [Legal Authority Explorer](https://gringo.bingo/#/legal-authority)
- [Immigration Forms](https://gringo.bingo/#/forms)
- [Adjournment Codes](https://gringo.bingo/#/adjournment-codes)
- [Bibliography and Sources](https://gringo.bingo/#/sources)

## Content and sources

Glossary entries contain English and Spanish terminology, definitions, aliases, and contextual notes.

The Legal Authority Explorer contains case law and statutory references, citations, holdings, and links to primary legal sources when available.

The Forms Explorer and Adjournment Codes Explorer document administrative forms and hearing-related terminology.

Government sources are linked for verification where available. The existence of a link does not imply endorsement by the issuing agency.

## Citation

Immigration Glossary | Glosario de lo migratorio
https://gringo.bingo/

When citing a particular authority, consult and cite the underlying judicial or administrative decision.

## Limitations

The project is incomplete and continually evolving. Legal authorities may be amended, distinguished, superseded, or overturned.

Users should verify current law and procedures against authoritative primary sources.

Refer to the project's published licensing terms. Government materials may have separate public-domain or reuse conditions.
